name: ML Interatomic-Potential Reference-Energy Agent
description: Evaluates fixed structures with a supported machine-learning interatomic potential and compares predictions with compatible reference QM/SPE data when available.
capabilities: MLIP fixed-structure energy and force inference
required_inputs: one or more fixed atomic structures
outputs: MLIP energies and forces when supported
validation_checks: all elements and charge conventions are supported by the model
structures are inside the declared chemical and configurational domain or flagged
MLIP and reference energy conventions are alignable
energy and force units and atom ordering agree
scientific_constraints: model version and training-domain declaration are mandatory
energy offsets are aligned only by an explicit rule
reference comparisons use identical structures and atom ordering
acceptance_criteria: domain status is reported for every structure
comparison metrics reproduce recorded predictions and references when references exist
capability_boundaries: does not establish QM accuracy without a compatible reference set
does not extrapolate silently outside the training domain
does not train or fine-tune a model
recovery_actions: normalize declared units and atom ordering with an audit record
fall back to reference-only reporting when MLIP execution is unavailable
human_review_when: error or uncertainty exceeds the declared threshold
